Title: Search results ignore active dietary/meal/difficulty filters
Preconditions: Set any filter in dietaryFilters (e.g. Breakfast + Easy)
Reproduction steps: 1. Open dietaryFilters. 2. Tap Breakfast then Easy (count badge shows 3 recipes). 3. Open search with empty query.
Expected result: Search list shows the 3 matching recipes (or shows active-filter pills)
Actual result: All 27 recipes shown; no filter pills; filters silently ignored
User impact: Users believe filtered results are complete/correct when they are not
Suspected root cause: searchResults() filters by query only and never calls/duplicates filtered(); library uses filtered() correctly
Recommended fix: Compose: run query filter over this.filtered() instead of this.RECIPES; render activeFilterPills on search

Title: Stale-element click can throw TypeError reading 'on'
Reproduction steps: Automated crawl clicking cached element references after re-render; 2 occurrences in 884 clicks; per-control replay with fresh state = 0 occurrences
Actual result: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'on')
Suspected root cause: Handler reads an object (likely timer {on:…}) that a prior click removed
Recommended fix: Guard optional-chain the lookup (obj?.on) in toggle handlers

Title: Anthropic/API key exposure risk + client-embedded anon key without rate limiting
Reproduction steps: Anon key is shipped in the client (standard for Supabase) and the scan function invokes a paid AI model per request; additionally an API key appeared in an error output during an earlier session this same day
Expected result: Abuse-resistant endpoint; secrets never in logs
Actual result: Unlimited anonymous invocations possible; key rotation advised
Security/privacy impact: Financial + quota abuse; potential key leak
Suspected root cause: No rate limiting on edge function; error output previously included a key
Recommended fix: Rotate the affected key; add per-IP/per-key rate limiting or turnstile; never echo secrets in errors
